verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own marketing claims a secure built-in data room for sharing diligence materials. It also documents advanced permissions over who can view or modify equity data, plus centralized documents and stakeholder access, so the core capability exists. The evidence is a one-line mention with no detail on how it works or how well. Missing for 10: detail on data-room permission controls for external counsel and investors, evidence that cap table views are shared inside the data room alongside the documents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors

citations.quote: share diligence materials through a secure built-in data room
